description: This file defines React functional components used for layout and structural elements of a dashboard UI, such as DashboardShell, DashboardHeader, and DashboardMain. It exports these components for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: DashboardShell
methods.description: A React component that provides a flexible container layout for the dashboard content, applying classes for flex layout, height, overflow, background, and font.

methods.name: DashboardHeader
methods.description: A React component that renders a header section with styling for height, border, flex alignment, padding, background, and layering, used for the dashboard header.

methods.name: DashboardMain
methods.description: A React component that renders the main content area with flex layout, overflow handling, suitable for the main dashboard content section.
